dialogues.speaker: Portrait Canvas
dialogues.text: (A blank canvas which will soon be used to draw a lovely picture of one of the Five Kasen.)

dialogues.speaker: Suikou's Likeness
dialogues.text: (This is Suikou's likeness, as done by Albedo.)

dialogues.speaker: Suikou's Likeness
dialogues.text: (Venti was used as the model for this work, and it shows Suikou prone after getting dead drunk. It also incorporates some unique fashion features from Mondstadt.)

dialogues.speaker: Suikou's Likeness
dialogues.text: (Venti seems to love this picture very much, and a certain someone has had to remind him several times that he's not actually in the picture.)
